import random

def kth_largest(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """
    Return the k-th largest element in an unsorted list using the Quickselect algorithm.
    Time complexity is O(n) on average.
    """

    def partition(left: int, right: int, pivot_index: int) -> int:
        pivot_value = nums[pivot_index]
        # Move pivot to the end
        nums[pivot_index], nums[right] = nums[right], nums[pivot_index]
        store_index = left
        
        for i in range(left, right):
            if nums[i] > pivot_value:  # For k-th largest, use '>' for the correct order
                nums[store_index], nums[i] = nums[i], nums[store_index]
                store_index += 1
        
        # Move pivot to its final place
        nums[right], nums[store_index] = nums[store_index], nums[right]
        return store_index

    def quickselect(left: int, right: int, k_smallest: int) -> int:
        if left == right:  # Only one element in the range
            return nums[left]

        pivot_index = random.randint(left, right)
        pivot_index = partition(left, right, pivot_index)

        if k_smallest == pivot_index:  # Found the k-th largest
            return nums[k_smallest]
        elif k_smallest < pivot_index:  # Go left
            return quickselect(left, pivot_index - 1, k_smallest)
        else:  # Go right
            return quickselect(pivot_index + 1, right, k_smallest)

    return quickselect(0, len(nums) - 1, k - 1)
